    z=float(D[int(v),int(u)]); p=np.linalg.inv(K)@np.array([u,v,1])*z; p[1:]*=-1

    return T

def calibrate():
    global Rbase,Rcam,tbase,tip
    init=np.r_[np.zeros(3),Rotation.from_matrix(fk(samples[0][0])[:3,:3].T@samples[0][2]).as_rotvec()]
    def residual(x):
        B=Rotation.from_rotvec(x[:3]).as_matrix(); C=Rotation.from_rotvec(x[3:]).as_matrix()
        return np.concatenate([Rotation.from_matrix((B@fk(q)[:3,:3]@C).T@R).as_rotvec() for q,p,R in samples])
    fit=least_squares(residual,init)
    Rbase=Rotation.from_rotvec(fit.x[:3]).as_matrix(); Rcam=Rotation.from_rotvec(fit.x[3:]).as_matrix()
    A=np.concatenate([np.c_[np.eye(3),Rbase@fk(q)[:3,:3]] for q,p,R in samples]); b=np.concatenate([p-Rbase@fk(q)[:3,3] for q,p,R in samples]); x=np.linalg.lstsq(A,b,rcond=None)[0];tbase=x[:3];tip=x[3:]
    print('calibration',np.linalg.norm(fit.fun),np.linalg.norm(A@x-b),'base',tbase,'tip',tip,'Rbase',Rbase,'Rcam',Rcam)
def predict(q):
    T=fk(q);return Rbase@(T[:3,3]+T[:3,:3]@tip)+tbase,Rbase@T[:3,:3]@Rcam

def ik(pos,R=None,qseed=None):
    qcur=state()[4:11].copy();qseed=qcur if qseed is None else qseed
    R=crot() if R is None else R
    def fun(q):
        p,Rq=predict(q)
        return np.r_[(p-pos)*8,Rotation.from_matrix(R.T@Rq).as_rotvec(),.015*(q-qcur)]
    fit=least_squares(fun,qseed,bounds=([-2.89,-1.76,-2.89,-3.06,-2.89,-.01,-2.89],[2.89,1.76,2.89,-.07,2.89,3.75,2.89]),max_nfev=300)
    print('ik residual',fun(fit.x)[:6]);return fit.x

def goto(pos,R=None,grip=-1,n=60,label='goto'):
    q=ik(np.array(pos),R);return move(q,grip,n,label=label)
